blurb: Begin at LB Tavern, the Lord Baltimore Hotel's modern take on a classic hotel bar, with handcrafted cocktails, local craft beer, and dinner available under the same roof as the theatre. Then find your seat for world-class magic and stay for a ghost tour or an after-hours performance. Arrive at least 90 minutes early for dinner or 30 minutes early for drinks.
